rationale: Most stage_kv/interface.py-specific ground-truth comments (P1 geometry/digest/block-count/null-block checks) target an earlier revision of the code no longer present in this diff snapshot, so recall for both is capped low; the coverable ground-truth themes are the meta concerns about redundant cross-layer validation (asukaqaq-s) and the executor-leak-on-init-failure fix. Y hits both more directly: finding #7 explicitly identifies duplicate identity checks across layers (matching asukaqaq-s's core complaint), finding #2's proposed DTO invariants closely mirrors the reviewer's suggested 'construction-time invariants' taxonomy, and Y credits the engine-cleanup fix with added nuance about scheduler ownership. Y also surfaces a genuinely new, well-grounded, high-value bug (ARDiffusionModelRunner signature mismatch) that neither ground truth nor X caught. X is tighter and its two findings (batch/step skip pre-RPC identity validation; DLO fallback silently serializes) are well-grounded and highly actionable, giving it slightly higher precision, but its narrower scope covers less ground-truth territory than Y's broader sweep.
